intensity_mean.definition: Mean pixel luminance across the brain MRI slice.
intensity_mean.clinical_note: Reflects baseline overall scan exposure and bulk tissue signal intensity.

intensity_std.clinical_note: Measures intensity dispersion and macroscopic tissue contrast variability.

intensity_skewness.clinical_note: Quantifies asymmetry: positive skew indicates predominance of hyperintense signals.

intensity_kurtosis.definition: Excess kurtosis of the pixel intensity distribution.
intensity_kurtosis.clinical_note: High kurtosis indicates heavy-tailed distribution with concentrated focal intensities.

glcm_contrast.definition: Mean spatial Gray-Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) contrast.
glcm_contrast.clinical_note: Reflects local textural variation between neighboring voxels; high in heterogeneous lesions.

glcm_homogeneity.clinical_note: Measures textural uniformity; high in uniform cerebrospinal fluid or homogenous white matter.

glcm_energy.clinical_note: Measures repetition of pixel pairs; approaches 1 for uniform constant regions.

glcm_correlation.definition: Mean GLCM linear dependency of gray levels.
glcm_correlation.clinical_note: Quantifies directional linear predictability between neighboring voxel intensities.

image_entropy.definition: Shannon entropy of the grayscale intensity histogram (bits/pixel).
image_entropy.clinical_note: Reflects information density and randomness; higher in micro-architecturally complex tissues.

canny_edge_density.definition: Fraction of pixels marked as structural edges via Canny detector.
canny_edge_density.clinical_note: Measures border complexity, anatomical boundaries, and internal tumor vascular margin density.

foreground_area.definition: Pixel count of the Otsu-thresholded intracranial tissue mask.
foreground_area.clinical_note: Exploratory 2D area proxy; NOT a true 3D lesion volume.

foreground_perimeter.definition: Boundary arc length in pixels of the dominant foreground tissue contour.
foreground_perimeter.clinical_note: Perimeter length of the primary contour.

circularity.clinical_note: Approaches 1.0 for circular geometries (e.g. pituitary adenomas), lower for irregular infiltrative margins.

eccentricity.definition: Eccentricity of the equivalent fitted ellipse.
eccentricity.clinical_note: 0 indicates round shape; higher values signify elongation or axis elongation.

box_counting_fractal_dimension.definition: Estimated box-counting Hausdorff dimension of thresholded edges.
box_counting_fractal_dimension.clinical_note: Measures boundary fractal roughness and infiltrative edge irregularities.

disclaimer: Image-level features represent exploratory 2D slice intensity and morphological descriptors. They do NOT establish true 3D tumor volume or validated clinical radiomic biomarkers.
